text:
maria: quick idea: surface the runtime's actual route decision in Console so support/devs can see when routing inferred a different route than the client hint. low volume opt-in telemetry to start.
kevin: +1. need to be explicit about sampling and UI language so customers don't mistake samples for global splits.
tess: console UX: show observed vs hinted breakdown, sample size, and a confidence band. internal-only first.
roman: SDKs: expose opt-in flag, default off. we can map to header `X-RW-Observed-OptIn: true` for preview. avoid changing routing logic.
sarah: TS & Node: same shape. propose `client.configure({observedRouting:{enabled:boolean, sampleRate:number}})`. docs + changelog required.
ops: legal ok but add org-level opt-out + 30d retention default. audit when toggled.
kevin: rollout plan: internal lab -> SDK opt-in preview -> small public sample (1%) with banner -> tenant opt-in.
maria: action items: roman & sarah SDK PRs; tess mock UI; ops retention/opt-out; i'll draft announcement.
deploy-bot: routing-observed-ingest canary deployed to infra-canary-2 (2026.03.14-rc).
maria: thanks, will sync tomorrow after designs.
kevin: +1
